Services

Geoscience Services

Specialized geophysical and geological analysis to help reduce risk when quantifying reservoir properties.

Seismic Data Processing

Advanced techniques to enhance data quality and resolution with customized workflows tailored to specific geological challenges. TraceSeis applies rigorous processing methodologies to ensure reliable and interpretable seismic data.

Details on traceseis.com

Feasibility Studies

Thorough assessments evaluating data quality, geological complexity, and technical viability. These studies provide the foundation for informed decision-making before committing to larger-scale projects.

Details on traceseis.com

Lithofacies Prediction

Accurate predictions using integrated seismic and well-log data combined with rock physics modeling. This service helps characterize subsurface lithology and supports reservoir modeling efforts.

Details on traceseis.com

Inversion to Reservoir Properties

Proprietary methodologies that transform seismic attributes into porosity, saturation, and other reservoir parameters. TraceSeis's approach reduces dependency on Low Frequency Models, streamlining the characterization workflow.
